verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS calendar assistant, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a data-export feature, open-format downloads (e.g. CSV/JSON/ICS) or an account-offboarding flow, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. The docs only say Reclaim works on top of your existing Google/Outlook calendar rather than replacing it, which is not an export capability.
